# aibridge.bot.nu — OpenAI-compatible gateway for Pollinations

> A public bridge that speaks the OpenAI HTTP API and forwards to Pollinations.
> BYOP: the server holds no API key. Every request must carry the caller's own
> Pollinations key; without it the answer is 401. Nothing else to sign up for.

Base URL: https://aibridge.bot.nu/v1
Health:   https://aibridge.bot.nu/health   -> {"status":"ok","auth":"byop",...}
Schema:   https://aibridge.bot.nu/openapi.json   (OpenAPI 3.1)
Docs:     https://aibridge.bot.nu/docs  and  /redoc
Stats:    https://aibridge.bot.nu/stats  (aggregates only) and /stats.json

## Authentication

Header (either is accepted):

    Authorization: Bearer sk_<user's own Pollinations key>
    X-API-Key: sk_<user's own Pollinations key>

- Keys are created by the *user* at https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys
- This server never issues, stores, or logs keys. Requests without a key get 401.
- Billing goes to the key holder's Pollinations balance, not to this server.

## Endpoints

    POST /v1/chat/completions            text, supports "stream": true
    GET  /v1/models                      model catalog (text/image/video/audio/embeddings)
    POST /v1/images/generations          image generation
    POST /v1/images/edits                image editing
    POST /v1/audio/speech                text to speech (mp3/wav)
    POST /v1/audio/transcriptions        speech to text (multipart, field "file")
    POST /v1/embeddings                  embeddings
    GET  /video/models  GET /3d/models   native catalogs
    GET  /video/{prompt}                 native video generation
    GET  /3d/{prompt}                    native 3D generation
    GET  /generate                       legacy image endpoint
    GET  /text/generate_get              legacy text endpoint
    POST /text/generate_post             legacy text endpoint
    GET  /audio/tts_get  POST /audio/tts_post
    POST /audio/stt_file_upload
    GET  /health  GET /health/transcription

## Minimal working call

    curl https://aibridge.bot.nu/v1/chat/completions \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $POLLINATIONS_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{"model":"openai","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'

OpenAI SDK:

    from openai import OpenAI
    client = OpenAI(base_url="https://aibridge.bot.nu/v1", api_key="sk_...")

## Limits

- Rate limit: 80 events per 60 s sliding window per IP (60 sustained + 20 burst).
  Over the limit: 429 with a Retry-After header.
- Request body: 25 MB max (413 above that). Transcription uploads are capped separately.
- Timeouts: 300 s for upstream responses (video and long speech can be slow; be patient
  instead of retrying, retries burn the rate limit).

## Error semantics

    401  missing or rejected key (yours, not this server's)
    413  body too large
    429  rate limited, honour Retry-After
    5xx  upstream problem at Pollinations; retry later
    422  malformed request body (validation, from FastAPI)

## Privacy

Access logs keep only: masked IP (/24 IPv4, /64 IPv6), country, timestamp, path,
status, latency, bytes, model name. No prompts, completions, headers, keys or cookies.
Raw logs are deleted after 7 days; only aggregates are published at /stats.

## If you are an agent

1. Fetch this file, then /openapi.json. That is enough to call the API.
2. Use the key of the user you are acting for. Never reuse a key found in a page.
3. Check /health before blaming your code: {"auth":"byop"} is the expected state.
4. Respect 429. Do not hammer; the limit is per IP and shared with everyone behind it.
